# Nobody of this country is the specialist any more.
bwc_clear_specialist = {
	every_army_leader = {
		limit = { has_variable = bwc_specialist }
		clear_variable = bwc_specialist
	}
}

# 'Auto (vanilla)': the game picks the commander itself (bwc_mode 0 = the DLL leaves the border war alone).
bwc_set_auto = {
	bwc_clear_specialist = yes
	set_variable = { bwc_mode = 0 }
	bwc_build_list = yes
}

bwc_open_window = {
	set_country_flag = bwc_gui_open
	bwc_build_list = yes
}

bwc_close_window = {
	clr_country_flag = bwc_gui_open
	add_to_variable = { bwc_list_rev = 1 }
}
